Member Toolkit

Everything you need to compete.

Competition frameworks, key dates, and direct links — organized so you spend less time searching and more time winning.

01

The 3-Step Role-Play System

  1. Read & Identify — Find the Performance Indicators. Know them cold by event category.
  2. Build the Framework — Situation analysis → recommendation → implementation plan → measurable metrics.
  3. Executive Presence — Confident posture, professional vocabulary, controlled pacing. The judge’s lens is always on.
02

Written Event Blueprint

  • Executive Summary: One tight page — your entire case in 5 sentences
  • Situational Analysis: Data-driven. Generic analysis doesn’t win.
  • SWOT: Be specific to the scenario — judges can spot filler
  • Financial Plan: Show ROI. Numbers = credibility.
  • Appendix: Every source cited, every claim backed up
03

Performance Indicators by Cluster

  • Marketing: Product/Service Mgmt, Promotion, Selling, Market Research
  • Finance: Financial Analysis, Risk Mgmt, Accounting, Economics
  • Hospitality: Customer Relations, Operations, Event Planning, Lodging
  • Management: Business Law, HR Management, Operations, Entrepreneurship

The Eagle Legacy

Once an Eagle,
always an Eagle.

Norristown DECA alumni don't just remember their time here — they credit it. From scholarship wins to college admissions to career-defining interviews, these are the voices of the Eagles who came before you.

“I am unable to quantify the social skills and nuances that I gained through my participation in various DECA conferences around the country. Students who participate in the full range of activities offered by Norristown’s DECA chapter have reaped—and should continue to reap—the tremendous benefits that go along with the organization’s programming.”
Paul-David Perry II Former Chapter President & Treasurer • American University
“As soon as I mentioned that I was a member of DECA, my interviewer knew and understood how I had become such a successful student. The recognition I received helped me win an A.J. Drexel Dean’s Scholarship. DECA is not just a high school program—it is recognized by businesses and companies all across the United States.”
Jackie Lannutti Class of 2004 • State Champion • Drexel University Dean’s Scholar
“I’ll never forget that feeling of standing on a stage in Pittsburgh with a trophy in my hand and medallions around my neck. I’ll never forget the look on Mr. Shaw’s face when he heard that I won. That’s what DECA’s all about. It’s about giving a kid like me hope.”
Ricky Mancini 3× State Medalist • ICDC Finalist • King’s College

Chapter Recognition

Awards that define a standard.

Norristown DECA confers three elite honors to members who embody the chapter’s highest expectations in academics, leadership, and community impact.

◆
Senior Award

Jerry DiGiovanni
Memorial Award

Presented to a graduating member who demonstrates academic preparedness, community orientation, professional responsibility, and exceptional leadership through DECA. Named for an esteemed NAHS DECA alumnus who devoted over twenty years as Executive Director of Pennsylvania DECA, leaving an indelible mark on thousands of students across the Commonwealth.

♦
Distinguished Honor

DECA Diamond Award

The chapter’s most distinguished recognition, reserved for members who demonstrate outstanding dedication to leadership and provide significant support to NAHS DECA, the school, and the broader local community. A diamond-tier standard that few achieve.

△
Underclassman Award

DECA Emerging
Leader Award

Recognizes an active underclassman who is academically prepared, community-oriented, professionally responsible, and has demonstrated meaningful leadership potential through participation in DECA. Tomorrow’s officer corps starts here.
